item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes a statutory determination to terminate GSP preferential treatment for eligible articles imported from Portugal; the legal consequence is established by this presidential determination, with the proclamation supplying its effective operation.","evidence":"I have determined that it is appropriate to provide for the termination of preferential treatment under the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP)"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself amends the tariff schedules, removes Portugal from GSP eligibility, and fixes when that substantive change applies, rather than directing an agency to create the result later.","evidence":"General headnote 3(e)(v)(A) to the Tariff Schedules of the United States (TSUS), listing those countries whose products are eligible for benefits of the GSP, is amended by striking out \"Portugal.\""}]}
